items.docs: This API operation retrieves provisioning templates from Grafana's alerting system. It is accessed via a GET request to the `/v1/provisioning/templates` endpoint and returns a collection of message templates that can be used for alert notifications. items.docs: This API operation deletes a specific notification template from Grafana's provisioning system by its name. When called with a DELETE request to the endpoint /v1/provisioning/templates/{name}, where {name} is the unique identifier of the template, it removes the specified template from the system's configuration.
